name: Default
shortDescription: Media server for comics, manga, magazines and eBooks with a web reader, metadata management, OPDS, Kobo Sync and KOReader Sync support.

alerts.message: The first account created in the web UI becomes the administrator. Open the app right after deployment and create it.
Komga does not upload books through the browser: copy your CBZ, CBR, EPUB and PDF files into the data volume mounted at /data, then create a library pointing to a folder under /data.
